description: Count planning applications by LPA, year, decision outcome and application type, each with its base (applications held; applications with searchable documents); filter by any of them, so a householder refusal rate is one call. Count by validation date or by decision date (decided_from/decided_to, group_by decision_year). Narrow by the scheme facts read from each description: kind of work (work_kind, e.g. new_building), development category and net new homes (min_net_new_homes / max_net_new_homes), so refused new-build schemes of one to nine homes since 2023 are one call. Count by what the application proposes, read by a fixed rule from its description (filters.proposal: shared_house, a house in multiple occupation), so London's shared-house proposals by council and decision are one call; use it, not text, to count proposals. Optionally count only applications with a document mentioning a word or phrase (English full-text search). A mention is not a finding. examples_per_group returns randomly chosen example ids with example_records (each one's description, decision, outcome, kind of work and net new homes), with or without text: without text they are drawn at random from every application the filters keep, so ten random refusals decided in the last six months, from any council, is one call (filters.outcome ['refused'], decided_from/decided_to, no group_by, examples_per_group 10). Prefer that to a phrase when the filters alone say what is wanted. It does not search for people's names or home addresses: a query for one is refused.

AggregateFilters.description:
All optional, AND-combined. Field names and date meaning match
``search_applications_nearby``'s filters (one common language).

application_type.description: restrict to these application types; the shared list of application types, any case (council words such as 'Householder planning permission' are mapped onto it): householder, full, outline, reserved_matters, variation_of_condition, non_material_amendment, details_reserved_by_condition, listed_building_consent, advertisement, lawful_development_proposed, lawful_development_existing, lawful_works_listed_building, prior_approval, tree_works, high_hedge, eia_screening_or_scoping, observations_to_another_authority, ecclesiastical_exemption, other. A householder refusal rate is application_type ['householder'] with group_by ['outcome'].
application_type.title: Application Type

decided_from.description: inclusive decision_date lower bound — the recorded decision date, else a date the decision text ends in, as search_applications_nearby gives it; applications with no decision date are then excluded and counted in coverage. Applications decided in 2025: decided_from 2025-01-01, decided_to 2025-12-31.
decided_from.title: Decided From

development_category.description: Only these development categories: home_improvement | small_residential (1-9 net new homes) | medium_residential (10-49) | large_residential (50+) | mixed | tree. Read by a model from the description; applications not yet read never match.
development_category.title: Development Category

lpa.description: restrict to these councils, each a slug (e.g. ['havering','bromley']), name ('Leeds') or GSS code, at most 100 characters; omitted = every authority in the application index
lpa.title: Lpa

max_net_new_homes.description: Only schemes creating at most this many net new homes (as read from the description; 0 = none). 'A few homes' is min_net_new_homes 1 with max_net_new_homes 9. Applications not yet read never match.
max_net_new_homes.title: Max Net New Homes

min_net_new_homes.description: Only schemes creating at least this many net new homes (as read from the description).
min_net_new_homes.title: Min Net New Homes

outcome.description: restrict to these decision outcomes, normalised from each council's free-text decision: approved | refused | withdrawn | other | unknown (unknown = blank or a placeholder)
outcome.title: Outcome

proposal.description: restrict to applications that propose this, read by a fixed rule from each application's description (not from its documents, and not by a model): shared_house: a full or householder application (or one whose type is not known) whose description proposes creating, enlarging or keeping a house in multiple occupation (HMO, a shared house); condition discharges, variations, non-material amendments, certificates of lawfulness and conversions of an HMO into something else are left out. London shared-house proposals decided 2021-01-01 to 2026-10-31, approved or refused: filters.proposal ['shared_house'], decided_from/decided_to, outcome ['approved','refused'], group_by ['lpa','outcome']. Unlike text, which counts applications with a document that mentions a phrase, this counts what was proposed.
proposal.title: Proposal

validated_from.description: inclusive valid_date lower bound; applications with no valid date are then excluded and counted in coverage
validated_from.title: Validated From

work_kind.description: Only these principal kinds of work: new_building | demolition_and_redevelopment | extension_rear_or_side | extension_roof | basement | change_of_use | subdivision_or_amalgamation | external_alterations | internal_alterations | shopfront | advertisement | plant_and_equipment | telecommunications | renewable_energy | tables_and_chairs | tree_works | roof_terrace_or_balcony | public_realm_or_highway | temporary | repairs_and_restoration | other. New homes on a plot are new_building (and demolition_and_redevelopment where something is cleared first); a conversion is subdivision_or_amalgamation or change_of_use. Read by a model from the description; applications not yet read never match.
work_kind.title: Work Kind

AggregateFilters.title: AggregateFilters

examples_per_group.description: up to this many randomly chosen application ids (lpa_slug:app_ref) per group, for the caller to open and cite; example_records gives each one's description, decision, outcome and net new homes. Works in typed mode (no text): drawn at random from every application the filters keep, so ten random refusals decided in a window is filters.outcome ['refused'] with decided_from/decided_to and examples_per_group 10. In text mode drawn from the matching applications. At most 5 per group with group_by; up to 10 without group_by, where they are drawn over all applications in scope and returned on totals.
examples_per_group.title: Examples Per Group

filters.description: optional, AND-combined filters: LPA slugs, a valid-date window, a decision-date window, decision outcomes, application types, the scheme facts (kind of work, development category, net new homes) and what the application proposes (proposal, e.g. shared_house)

group_by.description: 0-2 of lpa | year | outcome | application_type | decision_year; year is the year the application was validated, decision_year the year it was decided; empty = totals only
group_by.title: Group By

limit.description: maximum groups returned, largest first (by matching in text mode, by held in typed mode); truncated=true when more exist
limit.title: Limit

text.description: optional: count only applications with a document that mentions this. Web-search syntax — "quoted phrases", OR, -exclusion; English stemming (newts matches newt). A mention is not a finding.
text.title: Text

name: aggregate_applications
title: Count planning decisions
